limitations: Equality applies to ordered case-folded alphanumeric tokens. The comparison excludes the ASF preface and disregards whitespace, punctuation, and comment decoration. It establishes neither byte identity nor legal equivalence across variants.
The SPDX `seeAlso` Apache locator differs from the ASF plaintext URL. The correspondence is limited to the captured ASF example and pinned SPDX record.
The release tag is unsigned. The release-to-commit finding relies on the tag object served by GitHub for the SPDX repository.
